meta.title: Languages per City x Resources
meta.grain: one row per location cluster x language spoken there
meta.why: 399 of 1,646 clusters are multi-language — a city-level bridge can exist that a country average hides.
meta.place_caveat: A location is a cluster of people-group pins within ~25km, NOT a municipal boundary. An empty place_name is an unnamed cluster, never an invented one.
meta.resolution_caveat: resolved:false means the language LABEL did not match an ISO 639-3 record here — its resource status is UNKNOWN, not absent.
meta.pools_caveat: Resource status is from eBible + JESUS Film only. GRN and FCBH audio are key-blocked.
